problems.reason: Sentence 4 states the holotype was sexually mature, while sentence 18 suggests it might have been immature based on bone fusion.
Sentence 13 assigns Antarctopelta to the subfamily Parankylosauria, whereas sentence 15 declares it incertae sedis within Ankylosauria.
Sentence 14 claims Antarctopelta is the most basal nodosaurid, but sentence 15 says its family assignment is uncertain.
Both sentences state that the only known specimen (holotype) was discovered, repeating the same fact.

notes: - contradiction: "A 2019 histological analysis revealed that the individual represented by the holotype was sexually mature." / "It is debated whether the individual was immature based on bone fusion, as histological analysis suggests it was sexually mature.": Sentence 4 states the holotype was sexually mature, while sentence 18 suggests it might have been immature based on bone fusion.
